legacy_semantics: boundtop computes atmospheric supply/demand q0 and a provisional flux q1 including previous ponding storage.
It computes the surface pressure head h0 that would result if the provisional flux were imposed using the saturated surface conductivity.
If h0 <= 1e-6 cm, the flux boundary remains valid and qtop=q1 with zero ponding.

If h0 > 1e-6 cm, ponding occurs: ftoph becomes true, saturated surface conductivity is used, runoff becomes possible, and a ponding state is computed instead of continuing an unrestricted prescribed-flux boundary.
During headcalc, ftoph selects a surface-head/Darcy residual branch; otherwise the top residual uses qtop as a flux boundary.
The ponding-layer balance explicitly includes pond storage change, precipitation/irrigation/melt/runon, evaporation, runoff and infiltrating qtop.

e3d_implication.finding: The E3D scaffold kept a prescribed flux-only top boundary through the attempted h=0 crossing and supplied no surface-water/ponding degree of freedom. That is not the source-bound SWAP surface transition semantics once the imposed flux would require positive surface head.
e3d_implication.qualification_effect: E3D remains a valid negative test of the flux-only scaffold but may not be interpreted as evidence that RossFast saturation physics itself is invalid.
e3d_implication.required_next_design: Qualify saturation transition with an event-aware top-boundary contract that conserves excess supply into explicit surface storage and switches to a head/Darcy infiltration branch when the flux boundary becomes inadmissible. The surface-storage owner belongs outside the soil-water solver state but must participate transactionally in the composed trial.

architecture_binding: Do not encode rainfall/ponding policy inside the Ross soil-water face solver.
The soil-water solver must expose the hydraulic response needed by a top-boundary component; the runtime/component composition owns supply, surface storage, runoff and event switching.
A rejected saturation-event trial may modify neither committed soil state nor committed surface-water storage.
Mass conservation across atmosphere/surface/soil remains hard and may not be repaired by clipping flux or head.
The event time is generic and may occur inside any [t0,t1] interval; no midnight/day assumption is allowed.
hard_nonclaims: This reconciliation does not qualify the legacy boundtop implementation for SWAP5 production.
This does not require copying legacy global state or module structure.
This does not qualify runoff, macropores or evaporation.
This does not yet prove RossFast versus FullRichards equivalence across the composed saturation event.
